tools.seoTitle: IP Address Extractor — Extract IPv4 & IPv6
tools.seoDescription: Server logs, request headers and diagnostics become an organized inventory of IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, classified by type and stripped of duplicates.

tools.name: Domain Extractor
tools.description: Extract hostnames from URLs and email addresses, remove common www prefixes, deduplicate domains, sort them, and export a clean domain inventory.
tools.seoTitle: Domain Extractor — Extract Domains from URLs
tools.seoDescription: Boil a list of URLs or email addresses down to their root hostnames, drop common www prefixes, remove repeated entries and download a clean domain inventory.

tools.name: HTML Link Extractor
tools.description: Parse raw HTML and extract anchor URLs, visible text, rel attributes, target values, and optionally resolved relative links using a base URL.
tools.seoTitle: HTML Link Extractor — Extract Links from HTML
tools.seoDescription: Feed raw HTML to this parser and collect every anchor URL with its visible text, rel and target attributes, resolving relative links against a base address.

tools.name: HTML Image Extractor
tools.description: Extract image URLs from HTML img tags, srcset, picture sources, Open Graph image tags, and Twitter image metadata for audits and research.
tools.seoTitle: HTML Image Extractor — Extract Image URLs
tools.seoDescription: Harvest image references from HTML: standard img tags, srcset candidates, picture sources and Open Graph or Twitter preview images, all deduplicated.

tools.name: HTML Metadata Extractor
tools.description: Inspect HTML title, description, canonical, robots, Open Graph, Twitter cards, favicon, language, theme color, and heading content in a structured list.
tools.seoTitle: HTML Metadata Extractor — Inspect Page SEO Data
tools.seoDescription: Audit a page's head section in a single view: title, meta description, canonical, robots directives, social cards, favicon, language and heading outline.

tools.name: JSONPath Extractor
tools.description: Query nested JSON with property selectors, array indexes, wildcards, recursive descent, unions, slices, and simple comparison filters. Copy matching values and paths.
tools.seoTitle: JSONPath Extractor — Query & Extract JSON Data
tools.seoDescription: Drill into deeply nested JSON using JSONPath expressions, wildcards, slices and filters, then copy out matching values or their exact paths for reuse.

tools.name: Regex Extractor
tools.description: Run custom regular expressions against text, inspect capture groups and character positions, use common extraction presets, and export structured matches.
tools.seoTitle: Regex Extractor — Extract Matches & Capture Groups
tools.seoDescription: Write or paste a regular expression, run it across your text, inspect capture groups and match positions, or begin from presets for emails, URLs and IPs.

tools.name: CSV Column Extractor
tools.description: Load CSV locally, preview headers, choose only the columns you need, remove duplicate rows, sort records, and export clean CSV data.
tools.seoTitle: CSV Column Extractor — Select & Export Columns
tools.seoDescription: Load a CSV file, preview its headers and keep only the columns you need; duplicates can be removed and rows sorted before exporting a lean new sheet.
